intent: Advance RLL as deterministic software development to the last piece that can be sustained without model training, AI runtime, silent physics changes, or scientific claim promotion.

exact_parity.boundary: Implementation/receipt parity only; not a fresh fit or model-selection claim.

global_legacy_dependency_debt.migration_rule: port -> parity gate -> switch/add route -> preserve legacy -> rollback

open_contract_divergences: Current Structure-D/Rx parity contract uses Omega_r=9.0e-5; FASE18E/freestanding contract uses 9.18e-5.
Current Structure-D growth proxy differs from freestanding growth including D(z).
Current Structure-D compressed-CMB historical semantics differ from freestanding r_s(z_star) semantics.
Current Structure-D/Rx data surface N=60 differs from freestanding joint surface N=65 because H(z) datasets differ.
A single RX-PHYSICS-CANONICAL-V2 is not selected automatically.

stop_condition.reason: The next unification step would choose scientific semantics between already reproducible versioned contracts, or migrate unrelated legacy files whose semantic parity must be handled family-by-family. Neither is a safe silent refactor.
next_allowed_routes: Create/version RX-PHYSICS-CANONICAL-V2 with explicit scientific decisions and parity vectors.
Select one legacy dependency family from results/rx_dependency_migration_plan.json and migrate it behind a dedicated parity gate.

R3.F_ok: Deterministic no-AI zero-third-party active RLL program is implemented and CI-verified, including exact Rx<->freestanding Q16 parity and Structure-D Rx successor.
R3.F_gap: One canonical physics contract is not silently chosen; global legacy external dependencies remain a typed migration backlog.
R3.F_next: Choose/version a physics contract explicitly or migrate one legacy dependency family with its own parity gate; do not mass-rewrite.

rollback: All changes are additive/versioned; legacy numerical pipelines remain preserved. Revert individual Rx commits/routes without rewriting historical receipts.
